overview.Name: Enchanted Wilds
overview.Live dates: August 26, 2026 (patch notes published August 25) to present
overview.Theme: A living, magical forest (Elderwood, Fae, Coven, Blossom, Lunar, Solar, Primal, Riftbeast, Thornmaiden). First TFT set on Unreal Engine.

mechanics: Wisps: forest spirits sold in the rightmost shop slot during the planning phase; they disappear after planning and reveal the fifth unit behind them. Wisps appear in every other shop and only one can be bought per round. They are split into 7 categories: Champion, Combat, Misc, Shop, Gold/XP, Risky, Item. Later Wisps are stronger and cost more. After stage 5 every other Wisp is guaranteed to be a Combat Wisp. Wisps are an iteration on Set 12 Charms.
The carousel returned (it had been replaced by Realm of the Gods in Set 17), with higher odds of higher-cost champions.
Set 17 Space Gods stays playable alongside Set 18.
Targeting: units no longer retarget after coming out of crowd control.
PvE loot missed at 4-7 or later PvE rounds overflows to the next PvE round.
Opening encounters were overhauled: high-variance encounters removed; standardized options added (Completed Item Anvil start, Reroll Subscription, Item Forge).

Avatar trait (Lux): Lux has nine trait variants; owning an Avatar converts other Avatars in your shop to its trait, and the chosen trait counts twice. Elder Dragon takes two team slots and gives +2 Riftbeast.
Coven gathers Essence from kills and losses and converts it into rewards at thresholds; Blackthorn sacrifices the unit on the Blackthorn hex before combat for team HP. See traits.
4-star champion values exist in the data (curve column 4); this file shows 1 to 3 star values.

Set 18 moved to Unreal Engine and CommunityDragon `https://raw.communitydragon.org/latest/cdragon/tft/en_us.json` (TFTSet18) stores names and base stats but no ability variables, so MetaTFT is the primary source here; CDragon base stats were cross-checked for the first unit. Mechanic text: Riot "Teamfight Tactics patch 18.1" notes (teamfighttactics.leagueoflegends.com), mobalytics.gg "Set 18 mechanic: Wisps", invenglobal.com (Unreal Engine transition). Ability values listed as "(scales with AttackDamage)" are the stored coefficients; the data does not state the unit (they are likely percent of AD). Values marked "unknown" sit between curve keys that the data does not define.
